import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] adj;
    static ArrayList<Integer> to, rev, cap;
    static int[] levelArr, itArr;
    static int n, t;
    static int S, T;
    static int rp, cp;
    static int in;
    static int[][] srcId, sinkId;
    static int[][] mark, dist;
    static char[][] grid, grid2;
    static int[] dr = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dc = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int c) {
        int a = to.size();
        to.add(v);
        cap.add(c);
        rev.add(adj[v].size());

        int b = to.size();
        to.add(u);
        cap.add(0);
        rev.add(adj[u].size());

        adj[u].add(a);
        adj[v].add(b);
    }

    static boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(levelArr, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        levelArr[s] = 0;
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int e : adj[v]) {
                if (cap.get(e) > 0 && levelArr[to.get(e)] == -1) {
                    levelArr[to.get(e)] = levelArr[v] + 1;
                    q.add(to.get(e));
                }
            }
        }
        return levelArr[t] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int t, int f) {
        if (v == t) return f;
        for (int i = itArr[v]; i < adj[v].size(); ++i) {
            itArr[v] = i;
            int e = adj[v].get(i);
            if (cap.get(e) > 0 && levelArr[v] + 1 == levelArr[to.get(e)]) {
                int pushed = dfs(to.get(e), t, Math.min(f, cap.get(e)));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    cap.set(e, cap.get(e) - pushed);
                    cap.set(rev.get(e), cap.get(rev.get(e)) + pushed);
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxflow(int s, int t) {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfs(s, t)) {
            Arrays.fill(itArr, 0);
            while (true) {
                int pushed = dfs(s, t, 1 << 30);
                if (pushed == 0) break;
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static boolean valid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && r < n && c >= 0 && c < n;
    }

    static void searchEdges(int a, int b) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(mark[i], 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Y') mark[i][j] = 1;

        q.add(new int[]{rp, cp});
        q.add(new int[]{a, b});
        dist[a][b] = 0;
        dist[rp][cp] = 0;
        mark[a][b] = 1;
        mark[rp][cp] = 2;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] now = q.poll();
            int r = now[0], c = now[1];
            if (mark[r][c] == 1 && grid2[r][c] > '0' && grid2[r][c] <= '9')
                add_edge(srcId[a][b], sinkId[r][c], 9);

            if (mark[r][c] == 1 && dist[r][c] == t) continue;

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = r + dr[k], nc = c + dc[k];
                if (valid(nr, nc) && mark[nr][nc] == 0) {
                    mark[nr][nc] = mark[r][c];
                    dist[nr][nc] = dist[r][c] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nr, nc});
                } else if (mark[r][c] == 1 && valid(nr, nc) && mark[nr][nc] == 2 && dist[nr][nc] == dist[r][c] + 1 && grid2[nr][nc] > '0' && grid2[nr][nc] <= '9') {
                    add_edge(srcId[a][b], sinkId[nr][nc], 9);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        S = 202;
        T = 203;
        in = 0;

        adj = new ArrayList[MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        to = new ArrayList<>();
        rev = new ArrayList<>();
        cap = new ArrayList<>();
        levelArr = new int[MAXN];
        itArr = new int[MAXN];

        srcId = new int[21][21];
        sinkId = new int[21][21];
        mark = new int[21][21];
        dist = new int[21][21];
        grid = new char[21][21];
        grid2 = new char[21][21];

        for (int i = 0; i < 21; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(srcId[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(sinkId[i], -1);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            grid[i] = line.toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    add_edge(S, in, grid[i][j] - '0');
                    srcId[i][j] = in++;
                }
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    rp = i;
                    cp = j;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            grid2[i] = line.toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (grid2[i][j] > '0' && grid2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    add_edge(in, T, grid2[i][j] - '0');
                    sinkId[i][j] = in++;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9' && grid2[i][j] > '0' && grid2[i][j] <= '9')
                    add_edge(srcId[i][j], sinkId[i][j], 9);
                if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9')
                    searchEdges(i, j);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxflow(S, T));
        sc.close();
    }
}
